_comment: Overlay adapting lookup_member_savings_balance@1 (recorded against Tenant A) to Tenant B, which runs the SAME underlying mock app configured/branded differently. Only what actually differs is patched: origin+route prefix, the checkpoint's route prefix, and the one form field whose HTML name= attribute differs (member_id -> acct_holder_no). The 'Search' button and 'View record' link steps need NO override at all -- both tenants render them from the same shared template with identical accessible names. Apply with: python3 -m src.cli replay --artifact-id lookup_member_savings_balance --version 1 --overlay artifacts/overrides/lookup_member_savings_balance@b.json --param member_id=1002
